hook: Tens of thousands of secret informants were just exposed in Hungary.

sections.voiceover: Tens of thousands of secret informants were just exposed in Hungary.
sections.visual_cue: Map of Hungary glowing on a dark background.

sections.voiceover: Prime Minister Péter Magyar launched the database Nyitottaktak.hu on November 4, 2026. Why did these secret police records stay hidden since the 1990 democratic transition in Hungary?
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of a computer screen showing the website Nyitottaktak.hu.

sections.voiceover: These archives remained locked in Hungary because efforts to open them repeatedly stalled for decades.
sections.visual_cue: Rusty padlock on an old document folder.

sections.voiceover: This database launch finally ends the state secrecy that plagued Hungary since the 1990 transition.
The files are finally open after decades of stalled efforts following the 1990 democratic transition.
